descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A1 · P2 · 无障碍

按钮 / 输入框 / 下拉框没有可访问名称（养老院的 +、设置、返回、关闭 X、任务完成 / 删除、用药状态下拉等），附带部分焦点跳顶、点按区域太小

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S21 「两个列表默认状态的 axe 扫描」 axe scan of both lists in their default state

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 2；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）
  • U7 Nursing Home: sort by room (unit/room), by name and by status each puts the residents in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane fixture, desktop / Pixel 7 / iPhone 15 profiles

When Visual lane runs axe on the screens it captures today: hospital-list (/rounding) and nh-list (/snf, Today's Visits), as opened, no search

Then No serious/critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations. The search box and the sort control have accessible names, and so do the icon-only add / scan / settings buttons

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core serious/critical violations = 0 on hospital-list and nh-list (visual-checks.ts). This covers the default state only: search typed, no-match, All Residents and the status-message announcement are S22. report.mjs does not key visual results per scenario, so S21's verdict is read from the hospital-list and nh-list rows of the visual report

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92581 ready for qa

养老院列表右上角的「+」（添加住户）和齿轮（设置）按钮没有名字，VoiceOver 只念「button」；医院列表有卡片里套垃圾桶按钮的问题，还有几处对比度不够（「1 patient remaining」、日期行、Handoff 按钮）。

On the Nursing Home list the '+' (add resident) and gear (Settings) buttons have no name, so VoiceOver just says 'button'; the Hospital list has the card/trash nesting problem and low-contrast text ('1 patient remaining', the date line, the Handoff button).

依据：visual lane, axe on desktop/iphone15/pixel7: 15 checks pass, 9 fail; button-name is critical. Oracle: serious/critical = 0 and icon-only add/scan/settings named. These are not in dev report §5, which lists only the unnamed dialogs.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。
